items.definition:
a bachelor's degree
She earned her baccalaureate in history.

the part of Earth where life exists
Protecting the biosphere is crucial for future generations.

the portrayal or description of a character
The characterisation of the villain was very complex.

an expert judge in matters of taste
He is a true connoisseur of fine wines.

a large formal assembly
The university held its annual convocation for new students.

the practice of seeking knowledge of the future or the unknown by supernatural means
Ancient cultures often relied on divination to make important decisions.

a fine dispersion of minute droplets of one liquid in another in which it is not soluble
Mayonnaise is an emulsion of oil and egg yolk.

the expulsion or attempted expulsion of an evil spirit from a person or place
The film depicted a dramatic exorcism scene.

an evil spirit or phantom, especially one that robs graves
The story featured a terrifying ghoul that haunted the graveyard.

a person from Ireland; relating to Ireland
The Hibernian cultural society celebrated St. Patrick's Day.

a socialist anthem
The crowd sang 'The Internationale' with passion.

A person involved in jihad.
The government is working to counter the influence of jihadi groups.

A scheming or crafty action or artful design intended to accomplish some usually evil end.
The political machinations behind the coup were complex.

A geological epoch from about 23 to 5.3 million years ago.
Many modern mammal groups first appeared during the Miocene epoch.

A drug derived from opium, used medically to relieve pain.
Morphine is a powerful opiate used in pain management.

Practice, as distinguished from theory.
The theory must be put into praxis to be truly understood.

A chronic skin disease.
Psoriasis causes red, scaly patches on the skin.

The beliefs of those advocating drastic social or political reform.
The rise of radicalism often occurs during times of social unrest.

A radioactive noble gas.
Radon gas can accumulate in homes and pose a health risk.

The state or power of reacting.
The high reactivity of sodium makes it dangerous to handle.

An act of retaliation.
The government warned against any acts of reprisal.

The action or process of delaying or slowing down.
The drug caused a significant retardation of tumor growth.

The action of imbuing something with new life and vitality.
The city planned a major revitalization project for the downtown area.

A historical term for an Arab or Muslim.
The Crusaders fought against the Saracens in the Holy Land.

an instrument used to measure properties of light
Scientists used a spectrometer to analyze the chemical composition of the sample.

a space that is part of a larger space
In mathematics, a subspace is a subset of a vector space that is itself a vector space.

the region immediately beneath the surface of the earth or a body of water
Geologists study the subsurface layers of the Earth to understand its structure.

a structure built on top of something else
The ship's superstructure housed the bridge and crew quarters.

the use or operation of telephones
The company specializes in advanced internet telephony solutions.

a large North American wolf
The timberwolf is a subspecies of the gray wolf found in North America.

the process of sorting patients to determine priority of medical treatment
In the emergency room, nurses perform triage to assess patients' conditions.

a small, independent magazine or booklet
She published her poetry in a small independent zine.

a position of dominant power or influence
The new party gained ascendancy in the polls.

lack of equality or equivalence between parts or aspects of something; lack of symmetry
The asymmetry of the design made it unique.

a form of theatrical makeup used by non-black performers to represent a black person
The use of blackface in performances is widely considered offensive.

a man who is a promiscuous and unscrupulous lover
He was known as a real Casanova in his youth.

a person who oversees the photography and camera work in filmmaking
The cinematographer was praised for the stunning visuals.

a chronic disease of the liver marked by degeneration of cells, inflammation, and fibrous thickening of tissue
Alcohol abuse can lead to liver cirrhosis.

an opiate used to treat pain, coughing, and diarrhea
The doctor prescribed codeine for her cough.

inflammation of the colon
He was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis.

the act of making something sacred
The consecration of the new church was a solemn ceremony.

the action or condition of becoming or being made wider, larger, or more open
The doctor checked the dilation of her pupils.

a person who dissents, especially from an established church or political party
The government suppressed the voices of political dissenters.

a person who deceives or tricks others
He was known as a duper, always trying to trick people.

the state of being involved in a complicated or compromising relationship or situation
The political entanglement made it difficult to reach a decision.

a salt or ester of glutamic acid
Monosodium glutamate is often used as a flavor enhancer.

a Spanish nobleman of the lower class
Don Quixote was a hidalgo who read too many chivalric romances.

the traditional or conventional images or symbols associated with a subject
The iconography of ancient Egypt is rich with symbolism.

a person who does not believe in religion or who adheres to a religion other than one's own
In historical texts, the term "infidel" was often used to describe non-believers.

a change in the form of a word (typically the ending) to express a grammatical function or attribute
English verbs have inflections for tense, such as '-ed' for the past tense.

an advance or intrusion
The company is trying to make inroads into the Asian market.

litany (a long, tedious list or series)
He recited a litany of complaints about the service.

locomotion (movement or the ability to move from one place to another)
The invention of the wheel greatly improved human locomotion.

maven (an expert or connoisseur)
She's a real fashion maven, always knowing the latest trends.

A person who initiates or creates something.
She was the originator of the idea for the new project.

A form or process of civil government or constitution.
The nation's polity was based on democratic principles.

the state of being first or most important
The company aims to maintain its primacy in the market.

a substance or mixture for use in chemical reactions
The chemist added the reagent to the solution.

a cancellation or postponement of a punishment
The prisoner received a last-minute reprieve.

a withdrawal of a statement, accusation, or undertaking
The newspaper issued a retraction for the false story.

the supposed communication of thoughts or ideas by means other than the known senses
Some people believe in telepathy, the ability to read minds.

the part of the body of a mammal between the neck and the abdomen
The insect's wings are attached to its thorax.

a small rocket engine used to propel or steer a spacecraft or missile
The spacecraft used its thrusters to adjust its orbit.

one tenth of annual produce or earnings, formerly taken as a tax for the support of the church and clergy
In ancient times, people paid a tithe to the church.
